Command.Name: ReadEJByDateTime_JSON
Command.FPOperation: Read Electronic Journal Report by initial to end date and time in the JSON format. The number of bytes equal to Length for JSON data must be read subsequently.

Arg.Name: OptionReportFormat
Arg.Desc: 1 character with value - 'T' - Detailed EJ - 't' - Brief EJ

Arg.Name: StartRepFromDate
Arg.Desc: 16 symbols for initial date in the DD-MM-

Arg.Name: EndRepFromDate
Arg.Desc: 16 symbols for final date in the DD-MM-
